layers.responsibility: Own precise offline JS/TS AST rule semantics and line-level ESLint diagnostics.
layers.must_not_claim: A reported candidate is a confirmed defect.

layers.responsibility: Run required quality adapters against the changed-file set and apply pre-review blocking policy.
layers.excluded_from_stack_ownership: Pre-CR's standalone context, editor-command, coverage-overlay, checklist, review, and debug product surfaces.
layers.must_not_claim: A passing receipt is merge approval.

layers.responsibility: Normalize quality evidence, add repository context, and order remediation without competing with detector semantics.
layers.excluded_from_stack_ownership: Quality Runner's standalone fleet audit and remediation product story.
layers.must_not_claim: A fallback heuristic is equivalent to an AST diagnostic.

fallback_contract.plugin_available: Consume Anti-Slop as the canonical semantic source and suppress matching advisory heuristics.
fallback_contract.plugin_unavailable: Run overlapping Quality Runner text heuristics only as labeled advisory fallback.
fallback_contract.plugin_analysis_failed: Preserve an explicit analysis failure; never reinterpret it as a clean result.
fallback_contract.dual_source: Emit one canonical finding with both evidence sources attached, never two user-visible findings.
